[ נֵץ ] noun masculine only suffix נִצָּהּ Gen 40:10 , see following II. נֵץ noun masculine a bird of prey , Generic name, including hawk and falcon (Tristr NHB ; accipiter Bo Hieroz. ii. 266 ff.; ed.
